module: Main "Rally Editor" window of the world editor (menu Gameplay > Rally Editor, edit mode "Rally Editor" / notebookEditMode, action map "rallyEditor"). It edits a rally notebook (notebook: *.notebook.json in a mission folder, under rallyUtil.notebooksPath) through tabs: notebookInfo, missionTab, voicepacksTab, pacenotes, drivelineTab, systemPacenotesTab, measurementsTab, aiCompetitorsTab, and testTab only if a dev.txt file exists at the root. It manages the current mission (currentMissionDir/Name/Id), voicepack selection (pick), a comparison "ghost notebook", auxiliary windows (DevTools, RallyToolbox, calibration, stage loader) and the rallyEditor.* preferences (editing, view, waypoints, ui). The other modules (tabs) call its getters (getPref*, getCurrentPath...).
usage:
local nb = editor_rallyEditor.getCurrentPath()  -- current notebook or nil
editor_rallyEditor.loadOrCreateForMissionEditor('/gameplay/missions/italy/rallyStage/001-...')
editor_rallyEditor.saveNotebook()
notes: Registered preferences: rallyEditor.editing (lockWaypoints [hidden], showPreviousPacenote, showNextPacenote, waypointSnapMethod), rallyEditor.view (pacenoteLabelMode "all"|"distance", pacenoteLabelDistance 100-1500 [650 default], pacenoteLabelNearCameraCount 0-10 [3], showAdjacentPacenoteText, showSelectedPacenoteUtility, drivelineSplinePrismWidth 0.5-5 [1.945], showAllPacenoteLabels [legacy, hidden]), rallyEditor.waypoints.defaultRadius (8, from 1 to 50), rallyEditor.ui.pacenoteNoteFieldWidth (300).
Bug: M.getVolatilePreferences returns the variable "volatilePreferences" which is never defined in this file; it therefore always returns nil.
The legacy preference showAllPacenoteLabels = true forces the "all" label mode.

moveSelectedWaypointForward/Backward, zoomIn and zoomOut are called directly by input actions with a value (0 = released, 1 = pressed); repetition is limited by a debounce (0.25 s for waypoints, 0.05 s for zoom). zoomIn/zoomOut/mouseWheelZoom only act if the active camera is "pacenoteOrbit".
The navigation shortcuts (selectPrevPacenote, selectNextPacenote, insertMode, deselect, selectNextWaypoint, cameraPathPlay, toggleCornerCalls) do nothing if the active tab is not Pacenotes.
Declared dependency: gameplay_missions_missions. The gameplay_rallyLoop extension is loaded/unloaded by the "RallyLoop Extension" checkbox in the Tools menu.
When the edit mode is activated then deactivated, resetEphemeralViewOptions resets the forest hiding option (theForest) and the foreground snaproad display.

devToolsWindowOpen.desc: Flag for whether the DevTools window is open (replaced on deserialization).

rallyToolboxWindowOpen.desc: Flag for whether the RallyToolbox window is open (replaced on deserialization).

picksMatch.desc: Alias of voicepack.picksMatch (compatibility with external callers).

notebookBasenamesForPick.desc: Alias of voicepack.notebookBasenamesForPick (list of candidate notebook names for a voicepack pick).

allowGizmo.desc: Returns whether the gizmo is allowed: true when the current edit mode is "Rally Editor".

buildVoicepackPickerEntries.desc: Builds the list of voicepacks offered for a mission (voicepack.buildPickerEntries with suffix "(mission)" for mission voicepacks).

returns.desc: Entries containing in particular a pick field.

cameraPathPlay.desc: Starts/stops playback of the Pacenotes tab's camera path; no effect if another tab is active.

changeDebugDrawOpacity.desc: Changes the debug draw opacity in steps of 0.2, clamped between 0.1 and 1.0: val = 0 decreases, val = 1.0 increases.

clearGhostNotebook.desc: Clears the comparison "ghost" notebook if it exists.

deselect.desc: Deselects in the Pacenotes tab (ignored outside this tab).

detectNotebookToLoad.desc: Chooses the notebook to load for a mission: resolution by voicepack, otherwise first existing notebook, otherwise "structured.notebook.json" to create.

returns.desc: Full path of the notebook file.

drawStageLoaderModal.desc: Draws the stage loading modal window (StageLoaderModal).

drawToolbarMissionContext.desc: Draws the text "mission | notebook | voicepack" (in cyan) in the toolbar with a tooltip; does nothing if there is no current mission.

getCurrentFilename.desc: Returns the file path of the current notebook.

returns.desc: currentPath.fname or nil if no notebook.

getCurrentMissionId.desc: Returns the current mission's identifier (e.g. "italy/rallyStage/001-ss-fastello-norte", extracted after "/missions/").

getCurrentMissionName.desc: Returns the mission's readable name (translated info.json name, otherwise last path segment).

getCurrentVoicepackPick.desc: Returns the current voicepack choice: {type='voicepack', scope='global'|'mission', dirname=...}.

getGhostNotebookError.desc: Returns the error from the last ghost notebook load.

getGhostNotebookLabelForPacenote.desc: Returns the label of the ghost notebook corresponding to a pacenote.

getGhostNotebookSelectedFname.desc: Returns the file name of the selected ghost notebook.

getGhostNotebookSelectedLabel.desc: Returns the label of the selected ghost notebook.

getMissionDir.desc: Returns the current notebook's mission folder (currentPath:getMissionDir()).

getMissionId.desc: Returns the current notebook's mission identifier (currentPath:getMissionId()).

getPrefDefaultRadius.desc: Preference rallyEditor.waypoints.defaultRadius: display radius of waypoints.

getPrefDrivelineSplinePrismWidth.desc: Prism width (vehicle width) used to draw the driveline spline.

returns.desc: Width in meters, clamped to 0.5-5 (1.945 by default).

getPrefLockWaypoints.desc: Preference rallyEditor.editing.lockWaypoints: locks the waypoint position.

getPrefPacenoteLabelDistance.desc: Camera distance beyond which the preview with no selection switches to the rainbow overview.

returns.desc: Distance in meters, clamped to 100-1500 (650 by default).

getPrefPacenoteLabelMode.desc: Display mode for pacenote preview labels.

getPrefPacenoteLabelNearCameraCount.desc: Number of pacenotes before and after the camera pivot that display their label.

getPrefShowAdjacentPacenoteText.desc: Returns whether the preview texts of the previous and next pacenotes are displayed.

getPrefShowAllPacenoteLabels.desc: True if the label mode is "all".

returns.desc: true if all labels are displayed.

getPrefShowNextPacenote.desc: Also displays the next pacenote when a pacenote is selected.

getPrefShowPreviousPacenote.desc: Also displays the previous pacenote when a pacenote is selected.

getPrefShowSelectedPacenoteUtility.desc: Returns whether the floating utility window of the selected pacenote is displayed.

getPrefUiPacenoteNoteFieldWidth.desc: Width of a pacenote's notes.note.freeform field.

getPrefWaypointSnapMethod.desc: Z snapping method when dragging a waypoint, before looking for the nearest snaproad point.

getViewSnaproadPathOnTop.desc: Returns whether the snaproad path is drawn in the foreground (ephemeral view option, reset to false when the mode is deactivated).

getVolatilePreferences.desc: Supposed to return the volatile preferences; returns the undefined variable volatilePreferences, so nil (see notes).

insertMode.desc: Activates the Pacenotes tab's insert mode (ignored outside this tab).

isCalibrationWindowOpen.desc: Returns whether the calibration window is open.

isPacenotesToolsSectionExpanded.desc: True if DevTools is open and its pacenote tools section is expanded.

isToolboxOpen.desc: True if the RallyToolbox or DevTools window is open.

isVisible.desc: Returns whether the "rallyEditor" window is displayed.

listGhostNotebookChoices.desc: Lists the notebooks offered as ghost notebook.

returns.desc: Choices (empty list if the ghost module is not ready).

listNotebooks.desc: Lists, sorted, the *.notebook.json files (recursive search) under a mission's notebooks folder.

folder.desc: Mission folder; by default the current notebook's (error if no notebook loaded).

loadForMissionEditor.desc: Sets the current mission, builds the voicepack list and applies the first one (which loads its first notebook); otherwise clears the notebook.

loadNotebook.desc: Loads an existing notebook (rallyUtil.loadNotebook), sets it as current, updates all tabs and recomputes the structured notes. Logs an error if loading fails.

loadOrCreateForMissionEditor.desc: Sets the current mission, removes the voicepack pick, detects the notebook (detectNotebookToLoad) and loads or creates it.

loadOrCreateNotebook.desc: Loads the notebook or, if not found, creates a new one (rallyUtil.createNotebook), then updates the tabs and recomputes the structured notes.

mouseWheelZoom.desc: Zoom of the "pacenoteOrbit" camera with the mouse wheel: val = 0 zooms in by 0.4, val = 1.0 zooms out by 0.4. No effect with another camera.

moveSelectedWaypointBackward.desc: Called directly by the input action: requests moving the selected waypoint backward (repeated with a 0.25 s debounce). Pacenotes tab only.

moveSelectedWaypointForward.desc: Called directly by the input action: requests moving the selected waypoint forward (0.25 s debounce). Pacenotes tab only.

onDeserialized.desc: Called after a Lua reload with the saved state: restores the mission, the voicepack pick (legacy "custom" picks are ignored), the notebook (or the pick's first notebook if the file no longer exists) and the state of the Toolbox/DevTools windows.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame by the editor: draws the window (File, View, Tools menus, tabs, keyboard and mouse inputs, auxiliary windows).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called at editor initialization, including after a Lua reload (Ctrl+L): resets references, creates the ghost notebook, declares the notebookEditMode edit mode, registers the window and the Gameplay > Rally Editor menu, instantiates the tabs and selects Pacenotes (or the first useful tab if there is no notebook).

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Declares the rallyEditor preferences category (editing, view, waypoints, ui).

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: If the hidden window is rallyEditor, switches back to objectSelect mode.

onSerialize.desc: Called before a Lua reload; saves the mission, voicepack pick, current notebook file and the open state of RallyToolbox and DevTools.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called on vehicle reset: forwarded to DevTools if it is open.

onWindowGotFocus.desc: If the window gaining focus is rallyEditor, activates the notebookEditMode edit mode.

openStageLoaderModal.desc: Opens the "Open Rally Stage..." modal window.

saveNotebook.desc: Saves the current notebook (currentPath:save()). Logs a warning if no notebook is loaded.

selectGhostNotebook.desc: Selects a comparison ghost notebook by file name.

returns.desc: Selection result; false if the ghost module is not ready.

selectNextPacenote.desc: Selects the next pacenote in the Pacenotes tab (ignored elsewhere).

selectNextWaypoint.desc: Selects the next waypoint in the Pacenotes tab (ignored elsewhere).

selectPrevPacenote.desc: Selects the previous pacenote in the Pacenotes tab (ignored elsewhere).

setFreeCam.desc: Switches to the editor's free camera, keeping the current camera's position and rotation.

setVoicepackPick.desc: Sets the active voicepack pick and automatically loads the first candidate notebook; if the pick has no resolvable notebook, clears the loaded notebook.

show.desc: Clears the selection, shows the Rally Editor window and activates the notebookEditMode edit mode.

showRallyTool.desc: Shows the window (or gives it focus), opens the Pacenotes tab and activates the notebookEditMode edit mode.

toggleCalibrationWindow.desc: Opens or closes the calibration window.

toggleCornerCalls.desc: Enables/disables corner calls in the Pacenotes tab (ignored elsewhere).

zoomIn.desc: Called directly by the input action: continuous zoom in (0.05 s debounce) of the "pacenoteOrbit" camera. No effect with another camera.

zoomOut.desc: Called directly by the input action: continuous zoom out (0.05 s debounce) of the "pacenoteOrbit" camera. No effect with another camera.
